title: Professional Practice
description: Can write and review technical artifacts a teammate can act on — and can keep fact, estimate and opinion separable in reviews, estimates and incident comms.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can write a pull-request description or technical note that states the problem, the change, a concrete verification step and what is out of scope — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can write a bug report a second person can reproduce from the report alone, and leave at least five review comments on a real change, each labeled blocking, suggestion or question.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently produce a written estimate or design-review note that names assumptions, at least one rejected option, and a check another person can run without asking the author.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can run incident communication that timestamps updates, keeps root cause out of live comms, and write a blameless postmortem with follow-ups tagged detect, prevent or respond.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's pull-request description, review thread or postmortem, name a sentence that presents interpretation as fact, and teach how to keep those apart on an unfamiliar change or incident.
